description:
## 1.36.0-dev.126 (2026-08-11)

- Reddit: move between comments through Compose's native directional focus traversal instead of sorting comments by virtual IDs or coordinates.
- Reddit: treat controls within one comment as a single logical stop while preserving Reddit's native focus behavior.
- Reddit: retain dev125's navigation-anchor preservation and use visible bounds only to recover after Compose recycles a scrolled page.
